test_name: Confluence API to Reference Topic with JSON Attachment

assertions.text: Skill correctly auto-detects document type as 'reference' from JSON content
assertions.evidence: JSON structure with API schema properties and configuration options detected correctly. System auto-identified as REFERENCE type despite Confluence page context.

assertions.text: JSON attachment is successfully extracted and parsed from Confluence page
assertions.evidence: search-api-config.json attachment successfully parsed. All endpoint parameters, configuration options, and response schema extracted and available in output.

assertions.text: HTML includes formatted table with API parameters: query, filters, limit, offset, sort, include_suggestions
assertions.evidence: Request Parameters table includes all 6 API parameters: query, filters, limit, offset, sort, include_suggestions. Each row complete with description.

assertions.text: Parameter table includes all required columns: Name, Type, Required, Default, Description
assertions.evidence: Request Parameters table has all 5 required columns properly labeled and populated. Additional columns (like range constraints) also included for completeness.

assertions.text: Configuration options are documented with: search_engine, semantic_model, timeout_ms, min_relevance_score, cache settings
assertions.evidence: Three configuration tables present: Search Engine Configuration (3 options), Ranking and Filtering (2 options), Caching Configuration (2 options). All required configurations documented.

assertions.text: Tables are properly formatted with consistent styling and readability
assertions.evidence: Tables use professional styling: alternating row colors, hover effects, proper font sizing, consistent padding. Headers styled distinctly. Code blocks use monospace font. Highly readable.

assertions.text: Pre-review report assesses parameter documentation and formatting
assertions.evidence: Comprehensive pre-review report with 87% compliance score. Assesses table quality, parameter completeness, code example clarity, and references specific DITA standards for reference topics.

notes: All assertions passed. Reference topic successfully generated from JSON API schema with complete parameter and configuration documentation. Excellent table formatting and code examples included.
